policies.mutation_authority: current primary of the owner barycenter

aliases./approach: with no current Air, create a parked Air, point the creator barycenter to it and issue one invite
aliases./approach CODE: consume the invite into pending_confirmation; never activates
aliases./accept: joining barycenter primary confirms its pending membership with activate=true
aliases./decline: joining primary declines a pending membership; issuer or Air-admin primary cancels its pending claim or withdraws its newest open invite
aliases./apart: the caller barycenter leaves its current Air; it never dissolves the Air

invariants: durable joined membership is separate from the barycenter active_air_id pointer
a barycenter has zero or one active_air_id and may retain multiple joined Air memberships
only the current primary of the joining barycenter confirms a pending membership
an Air is active only while at least two joined barycenters point to it; otherwise it is parked
parked Airs retain state, do not run audio and are not garbage-collected in phase two
accepted transmission target and policy snapshots never expand or change retroactively
joining an active Air catches up only the current main program and never autoplays an old overlay or interrupt
leaving stops or cancels audio only for the leaving barycenter unless the Air parks
the runtime resolves every barycenter through exactly one persisted authority generation
links and Airs are never simultaneously authoritative for playback
explicit target selection and offline inbox semantics are outside this contract
